_comment: Pinned identity of the MeepHash-W v2 WebAssembly build this slice will run.
meepow/wasm/meepow.mjs and meepow/wasm/meepow.wasm are gitignored BUILD OUTPUTS, not
committed files, so this manifest is how a reviewer knows which build was exercised. The
development pool hashes both files and refuses to import, instantiate or serve either one
unless it matches exactly. Cheap file integrity only: computing a SHA-256 of two small files
is not MeepHash-W and is not mining.
Regenerate with scripts/build-wasm.ps1 (or scripts/build-wasm.sh) and update these values
ONLY together with a recorded reason; do not bless a new hash to make a mismatch go away.
sourceOfTruth: meepow/src (frozen v2), built by scripts/build-wasm.sh under the pinned Emscripten in docs/TOOLCHAIN.md
recordedBy: docs/LOCAL_BROWSER_MINER_SLICE.md (the CURRENT rebuilt hashes). NOT docs/BROWSER_V2.md: that is a historical measurement report and correctly still pins the older artifact it actually measured, whose hashes are under previousArtifacts below.

_comment: The fixed synthetic job. It is read from the COMMITTED vector file
meepow/vectors/vectors_v2.txt, so the pool needs zero MeepHash-W computations before
a client declares start intent. meep_v2_setup() in meepow/wasm/meepow_wasm.cpp builds exactly the
context those vectors were generated from (nparents=4, fixed epoch key / seed hash /
8-byte template), which is why nonce N of that file is meep_v2_run1(N).
meep_v2_setup() is now a thin wrapper over meep_v2_setup_ctx() passing those same constants;
the fixture and these vectors are unchanged.
The build these hashes replaced, kept so a reviewer can see exactly what changed and when.
REASON FOR THE CHANGE: meepow/wasm/meepow_wasm.cpp gained meep_v2_setup_ctx / meep_v2_teardown
/ meep_v2_active / meep_v2_run1_checked, so a browser worker can hash an ARBITRARY frozen-v2
context instead of only the one synthetic fixture that meep_v2_setup() hard-coded.
THE CORE ALGORITHM DID NOT CHANGE. meepow/src/** is byte-identical; only the Wasm adapter in
meepow/wasm/meepow_wasm.cpp was edited. meep_v2_setup() is now a wrapper that passes the same
constants it always used, and the 20 committed vectors_v2.txt known-answer vectors still pass
unchanged -- that equality is the evidence, not this sentence.
